steps.title: Create Vault & End-to-End Encryption (E2E)
steps.subtitle: Protect sensitive credentials with military-grade AES-256 encryption
steps.description: Digital vaults safeguard your sensitive digital legacy: bank accounts, passwords, crypto assets, and inheritance documents. All sensitive data is encrypted before storage — not even server administrators can read your secrets.
points: End-to-end encryption: Only you and designated guardians hold decryption capability
8 specialized asset types: Banking, Cryptocurrency, Social Media, Email, and more
Independent vaults: Separate vaults for Family, Work, and Financial assets
steps.tip: Pro-tip: Start by clicking '+ New Vault' to store your most critical assets and instructions.

steps.title: Beneficiaries & Executors (Guardians & Heirs)
steps.subtitle: Establish a secure, transparent handover network
steps.description: LegacyVault cleanly separates asset recipients from legal procedural agents. You decide exactly who receives which assets and who is authorized to carry out your wishes.
points: Beneficiary: Receives designated assets and documents when the vault unlocks
Executor: Conducts forensic checks, submits legal filings, and oversees handover
Flexible allocations: Exclusive, proportional, full, or multi-party joint consensus (Shamir)
steps.tip: Pro-tip: Assign trusted family members as Beneficiaries and trusted counsel as Executors.

steps.title: Dead Man's Switch & Presence Tracking (DMS)
steps.subtitle: Hand over your legacy on time with zero false alarms
steps.description: The system monitors your presence via periodic check-ins (via Web or 1-click email). If you miss a deadline, a 3-layer safeguard workflow begins before any vault is unlocked.
points: 1-click check-in: Effortlessly confirm you are safe from email or website
Cross-confirmers: Real-world witnesses verify condition before activation
3-tier escalation: Proactive notifications sent before any trigger
steps.tip: Pro-tip: Add at least one reliable cross-confirmer to prevent unintended activations.

steps.title: AI OCR Forensics & Multi-Proof Asset Verification
steps.subtitle: Ensure authenticity and integrity of digital assets
steps.description: LegacyVault now features advanced forensic verification tools to prove ownership and legal validity before handover:
points: Death Certificate AI OCR (Gemini 3.6 Flash): Automatically extracts names, registry numbers, seals, and issuing authorities
Crypto Wallet Signature (Personal Sign): Proves MetaMask ownership via secp256k1 ecRecover without revealing private keys
Email OTP & SMS Sandbox: Verifies ownership of inboxes and e-wallet phone numbers
Cryptographic Fingerprint: Instantly invalidates verified status if asset metadata is modified
steps.tip: Pro-tip: In any Vault detail page, click the verification status badge to test out the new verification methods!
